gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-89.704796 39.767257)',4326)::geography, 1300)
  AND p.amenity = 'cafe'
  AND elev.z >= 160;

WITH malibu_jacks AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-89.704796 39.767257)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
buffered_area AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Buffer(geom, 1300) AS geom
  FROM malibu_jacks
),
it_grind_cafe AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.864121 34.279268)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
elevation_check AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Value(r.rast, ST_Transform(it_grind_cafe.geom, 4326)) AS elevation
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r,
    it_grind_cafe
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, ST_Transform(it_grind_cafe.geom, 4326))
)
SELECT 
  'It''s A Grind Coffee House, Moorpark, CA'::text AS cafe_name,
  elevation_check.elevation
FROM 
  buffered_area,
  it_grind_cafe,
  elevation_check
WHERE 
  ST_Contains(buffered_area.geom, it_grind_cafe.geom)
  AND elevation_check.elevation >= 160;
